_help: Act 1, after the brawl. If you won: Musa is down; help him up (musa_respect; in encounter B he won't fight you) or humiliate him (musa_enemy). If you lost (act1.gd sets brawl_lost): they take 10 and leave. Generated by tools/dialogue/make_act1.py.

lost.speaker: finch
lost.line: That's for the inconvenience. Ten pounds. Freddie's debt stands.

choices.label: Help him up
choices.line: Here. Up you get. Nothing personal.

choices.label: Humiliate him
choices.line: Stay down. Next time I won't be gentle.

respect.speaker: musa
respect.line: Not personal. No. I remember this.

finch_leaves.speaker: finch
finch_leaves.line: This isn't over, soldier. Freddie's debt doesn't go away because you can throw a punch.
